Why Recycle
Recycling keeps valuable materials out of landfills and turns them into new items. By using
what we already have, we save energy and cut down on using more of our limited natural
resources.
Where to Bring your Collected Recyclables
Option 1: Recycling at a Drop-offs
Recycling drop-offs and convenience centers are available for all Davidson County
residents. You can bring your recyclables to any location at no cost. If you plan to use a
convenience center, please note they are open Tuesday-Saturday from 8:30 am - 4:30 pm
and remember to bring your Davidson County ID or proof of residency.

Recycle Right: Drop-offs
Recycling rules vary slightly between our programs. At drop-
off locations, place ONLY these items in the bins. All
recycling MUST be sorted into the following four categories
and placed in the appropriate bin.
Food & Plastic Bottles,
Drink Cans Jars, & Jugs
Paper & Cartons Cardboard Glass Bottles & Jars
drop-offs ONLY
Pro tip: As you collect recyclables, sort them into these categories using separate bags.
This will save time and prevent extra sorting at the drop-off site.
Option 2: Recycling Curbside
If you’re part of our curbside recycling program, you can place mixed recyclables in your
green recycling cart. Please note that glass is NOT currently accepted in curbside
recycling.
